The observed support has 50 exact nodes 0.00 through 0.49, 14 independent batches and 700 batch-nodes inside the supplied learned window [0.0,0.5]. The joint FLOWR forward supplies both endpoint forecasts and a head score from pooled latent features; that score is not an independent coordinate-only affinity evaluation. These associations nominate geometry hypotheses, not causal binding regions. Every one of the 24 audited analytic curves has legendre_runtime_allowed=false and relative node RMSE above 0.35. The strongest eligible positive regional soft-mass association is landmark_00: whole-window z +0.6392349943936658, CI [0.4924599163269142,0.7906507287766374], q 0.00018794547124610335 and 14/14 positive batches, yet its first/last node contrasts are -0.36595078451489843/-0.2753379093708555. I therefore do not convert enrichment into constant attraction or universal covariance compression. Gaussian regions overlap, and parent-edge forecast increments and temporal contrast derivatives are not spatial forces or physical atom velocities. The information audit has nonnegative excess fixed-frame RMS 0.08097363029151962 A by construction and top-four overlap 0.46974125364431485; compressed/full chosen-teacher score correlations are 0.10182576506541118/0.06407848917780258. It supports studying coordinate detail without proving fuller coordinates improve affinity or explaining R7 causally.

No survival field passes q<0.05 across the joint 400-test family; minimum enrichment/rate q values are 0.12042655325259675/0.3018985343962196. There are 349/700 batch-nodes with fewer than three ancestors and 531/700 with fewer than six. Terminal-library teacher totals are 17 to 28 per node, with a per-batch cap of two. The last recorded joint head score is at t=0.99, followed by terminal state t=1.0 and one future resampling node per batch; it is distinct from the decoded final-molecule affinity rescore. Extinction has null future credit, never zero. Ancestor medians and full-window credit strata are not supplied, so collapsed coverage does not justify manufacturing high/low terminal-credit targets or multiplicity-weighted teachers. Keep the endpoint reference rather than switching to the terminal library on these survival summaries.

Conditional assignments, priors, endpoint anchor and self-conditioning stay fixed in the derivative g=J_FLOWR_endpoint(X_t)^T grad_Y R; affinity outputs are detached and excluded. No identity/saved-endpoint/surrogate derivative or affinity-head gradient is permitted, and additional production forward calls per step remain zero. The source geometry weights [0,1,2,1] monitor this direct point-cloud objective rather than reweighting it. The ratio uses the source predictive-flow calibration and existing bounds: at most 0.15 A atom step, 6 A cumulative RMS, seven backtrack attempts and 0.8 A severe receptor-clash constraint. Positive constant scheduled support applies at every exact controlled node unless the mathematical gradient vanishes; then native generation continues to t=1 with free atom/bond transitions, no graph veto, resampling or cloning. Detach native predictions/self-conditioning before native stochastic integration, then inject the bounded old-state VJP. Its lagged post-native reward response is first-order prediction only, not measured endpoint improvement.
